sources.title: Planul de Mobilitate Urbană Durabilă pentru Municipiul Iași — 24-hour aggregate traffic curve for three surveyed intersections
sources.notes: Aggregate across three sites, not directional edge counts and not unique journeys. Visual digitization from chart, approximately nearest 100 vehicles. No explicit weekday/weekend designation for this figure. Aggregation details not stated. No measurement uncertainty supplied. Raw annex tables not obtained. sources.title: Initial central network demand assumptions
sources.notes: Estimated mean600 departures/hour; passenger cars; Poisson arrivals; normalized PMUD aggregate hourly shape. Spatial distributions, eligible endpoints, and legal paths are automatically inferred from graph rules per run. No prescribed OD pairs or path library. Graph-capacity prior, synthetic signal programs, and transfer of aggregate temporal shape to this graph are assumptions; surveyed sites remain unmapped.
